integrity: Finite tables checked by two standalone source programs; a separate exact polynomial-divisibility proof extends the result to all permitted orders. No external independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the simple step-three generalized Petersen family with n >= 7; the previously known four-phase perfect-code minima and the equality with the step-two spectrum away from multiples of four are not claimed as new. Historical priority of the complete weight enumerator is not independently established.
title: The all-on switch-weight spectrum of \(\operatorname{GP}(n,3)\)
